prompt:
Create a NEW illustration in EXACTLY the visual style of the reference images.
STRICT STYLE: warm editorial illustration, soft painterly line and gentle shading, muted natural palette on a warm cream ground, grounded and human, picture-book register for adults. Warm cream ground (#EFE6D2), muted blue fills (#8FB0CE), soft dark ink line (#3B382F). Soft warm amber light.
Subject: A horizontal triptych, three equal panels in a row separated by plain cream gutters. The SAME modest home kitchen in all three, same angle, the SAME cook, one ordinary woman in a blue smock and apron, always with exactly two arms, no second figure and no extra hands anywhere. In front of her on the wooden counter sits ONE wide cooking pot. Behind her is a shelf of preserve jars and small ingredient bowls.
Left panel: she tastes from a wooden spoon held to her lips, brow slightly furrowed, considering. The pot is plain. There is nothing written down anywhere: no card, no paper, no notes. She is guessing.
Middle panel: a single pale card now lies on the counter beside the pot, ruled with faint lines and small tally marks, clearly a record of what went into the pot. She sets the last mark down. The pot is unchanged; only the record is new.
Right panel: she holds the card in one hand and reads it. With her other hand she reaches up toward EXACTLY ONE jar on the shelf, and that one jar glows warm amber while every other jar stays plain. One small bowl has been pushed away to the far edge of the counter, clearly set aside and removed. The pot itself now glows gently, on its way to right. Her posture is decisive, no longer uncertain.
TEXT, rendered EXACTLY as written, in clean small-caps serif lettering, dark ink on the cream margin, never over the artwork:
A title bar centered in the cream margin ABOVE the three panels reading: DEEP PROVENANCE
A short caption centered in the cream gutter BELOW each panel, left to right: NOT QUITE RIGHT / EVERY INPUT RECORDED / NOW YOU KNOW WHICH TO CHANGE
A footer bar centered in the cream margin BELOW the captions reading: GUESSING IS NOT ITERATING.
No other text anywhere. Do not invent any words. Do not write legible words on the card. Spell every string exactly as given.
No comic-book, no cartoon mascot, no flat vector, no neon, no 3D/CGI/Pixar, no photoreal, no anime, no identifiable recurring individual's face or signature clothing.
